sloka: आर्येण हि पुरा शून्या त्वयोध्या परिपालिता ।सन्तापं हृदये कृत्वा आर्यस्यागमनं प्रति ।। ७.६२.१२ ॥
transliteration: āryeṇa hi purā śūnyā tvayodhyā paripālitā ।santāpaṁ hṛdaye kṛtvā āryasyāgamanaṁ prati ।। 7.62.12 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, Ayodhya, though desolate, was formerly protected by the noble Bharata, who kept sorrow in his heart regarding the return of the noble Rama.
